resources.string: The microphone starts on request. Sending to Google requires separate consent.
Who promised to call me back?
What would you like to remember?
For example: discuss the project with Ali on Friday…
The note is stored on this device. Saving to memory does not send text to AI.
The note is saved on this device. Review the text before adding it to memory.
Delete the note and all its revisions from this device? Exported copies remain.
The JSON file contains all local notes, all revisions and the current draft in plain text. Exported copies remain after deletion in the app.
The result could not be confirmed. Check the entries and chosen file: the export file may be incomplete.
The draft in the file will be restored.
The current draft will not change.

At most three note previews are shown. Existing archive status is preserved. Notes deleted on this installation are not restored. Deletion markers are not exported: an old file may restore deleted content on another installation.
The file is damaged or its format is unsupported; data was not changed.
The import conflicts with a local draft, entry or deletion; data was not changed.
Data changed after the preview. Select the file again and review the new result.
The file or note count exceeds local storage limits; no data was changed.
Could not open or save data. Check available storage and retry.
Local storage limit reached. The note was not added; its text stays on screen.
The save result is unknown. Retry the same entry.
After you tap and allow microphone access, available on-device speech recognition is used. You can review and edit the text.
No entries match this filter or search.
Selected: %1$d. The action changes only archive status.
Add your first note by voice or text.
Check the export destination: the file contains plain text.
Tasks could not be opened or saved. Check storage availability.
Delete this task and its history from the app?
Delete all tasks and their history from the app? Previously exported copies remain.
The exported file contains tasks and their history as readable text. Choose a safe location.
Check date and time. Ambiguous clock-change times are not supported.
Reminders depend on device permissions and settings.
Open the app to see your task.
Notifications are off. Enable them in settings to receive reminders.
On-device speech recognition is unavailable. Use text input instead.
Microphone access was not granted. You can use text instead.
Speech could not be recognized. Try again or enter text.
Text exceeds 20000 characters. Split the note.
Azerbaijani is the primary assistant language. Memory search runs on-device; Google only receives separately approved text or audio.
The text below will be sent to Google Gemini for a response. Google may use free-service data to improve products. Your memory archive and tasks are not sent.
No response. Check your connection and Firebase setup, then retry.
Speech for this language is unavailable on this device.
Speech uses your device text-to-speech engine, which may use the network.

The microphone sends audio to Google Gemini until stopped or the app leaves the foreground. Google may use free-service data to improve products. Your memory archive and tasks are not sent. Sessions are limited to one minute. Saving text requires a separate review. Consent is saved on this device and can be revoked in settings.
Microphone is on and audio is being sent to Google. You can speak.
Session ended. Start a new one to continue.
Voice conversation is unavailable. Check your connection and model availability, then try again.
Could not read or save settings. Try again; previous settings are not overwritten automatically.
Change permissions in Android settings. You can type without microphone access.
Permission does not guarantee delivery or sound: device modes and system restrictions also apply. After a change, open Tasks to reschedule future reminders.
Could not open Android settings. Open the app settings manually.
A new version will be created. Previous text remains in history and exports.
Could not confirm the save. Retry or close and check the current text and history.
Versions are newest first. Times are UTC; device clock changes can make them differ from version order.
All local versions of this record will be deleted.
Add a note by voice or text.
Search sources saved on this device
No matching stored sources. Try a name or an exact phrase.
Information from confirmed records will appear here.
Notes and revisions are stored on this device. Sending to Google starts after your consent. Open Inbox for corrections and export.
Finish the current draft or wait for memory to load. No text was replaced.
Transcript limit reached. Session stopped; incomplete text cannot be saved as complete.
Record up to 25 seconds, then review and correct the transcript.

After consent, the microphone starts. The completed recording, up to 25 seconds, is sent to Google Gemini. Google also checks the writing system of the recognized text. Google may use free-service data to improve products. No audio file is saved; text is shown for review. Your memory archive is not sent. Consent is saved on this device and can be revoked in settings.
Writing system check failed. Review the original recognition carefully.
Check names, amounts and negation. Only the text you confirm will be saved.
Could not play audio. The answer is shown below.

With your consent, your voice and transcript are sent to Google Gemini. To produce speech, Google receives the answer, including the relevant name and amount. Google may use free-service data to improve products. Your entire memory archive is not sent. Consent is saved on this device.
Swipe left to open the menu
Saved transfers, debts and original text. Delete an incorrect entry and say it again.
This record will be removed from memory.
The exported file is not encrypted and contains personal data. Store it securely.
